marks.gloss_en: R' Abba bar Kahana: like those of your father's house
R' Chanina: the sedan-chairs of Rebbi's house may be moved on Shabbat
R' Chanina permitted Rebbi's house to drink wine [carried] in a gentile's wagons under one seal
a gentile who lit a lamp -- a Jew uses its light

איני?! והאמר רב הונא אמר רבי חנינא: one may stand his animal on grass, but not on muktzeh -- [so how may a Jew feed from the gentile's gathered grass?] (amoraic-memra contradiction; kind svara under protest)
דקאים לה באפה ואזלא היא ואכלה -- he stands in front of it, and it goes and eats
a person may stand his animal on grass on Shabbat, but not on muktzeh on Shabbat
אמר מר: ... אבל מכירו אסור -- הא רבן גמליאל מכירו הוה! -- but [the gentile] knew Rabban Gamliel
Abaye: שלא בפניו הוה (= p_abaye_shelo_befanav)
Rava: אפילו תימא בפניו, נר לאחד נר למאה (= p_rava_ner_leechad)
Abaye: [the ramp] was [made] not in his presence
מיתיבי: Rabban Gamliel said 'since he made it not in our presence, we will descend by it' -- so presence mattered
אימא: הואיל ועשאו נרד בו -- say: since he made it, we will descend by it
Rabban Gamliel said to them: since he made it not in our presence, we will descend by it
תא שמע: the bathhouse in a mixed city -- with a Jewish majority one waits, though it was heated without anyone's presence
התם, כי מחממי -- אדעתא דרובא מחממי: there, when they heat it, they heat it with the majority in mind
a city where Jews and gentiles live with a bathhouse operating on Shabbat: if most are gentiles, one may bathe in it immediately; if most are Jews, one waits the time it takes to heat the water
תא שמע: a lamp at a banquet -- with a gentile majority it is permitted [Steinsaltz: though at a shared banquet the gentile knows the Jew]
a lamp lit at a banquet: if most are gentiles, one may use its light; if most are Jews, forbidden; half and half, forbidden

had it taught only the lamp [one would say: permitted] because a lamp for one is a lamp for a hundred, but water -- let us decree lest he come to add [water] for the Jew; so the water clause is needed
a gentile who gathered grass -- a Jew feeds [his animal] after him
